name: itsryanlenk/cutlist
description: A video cut-list skill that builds cut lists and trims video, installed by a local copy or symlink installer with per-agent flags.
install: bash install.sh with agent flags (--codex, --claude, --cursor, --gemini, --copilot, --all, --global, --link, --into), copying or symlinking the skills/cutlist folder to the agent skills directory. install.sh is a local copy or symlink installer, not a pipe installer.
